The binder records exactly that set (binding.py:1453, ctx.bindings['declare_attackers']), but the IR can only read it as a number (QPropField.THAT_MANY_COUNT fallback, quantity.py:626); no Selector referent (source/controller/target/event/result) selects it, and referent 'event' is a single attacker row. The nearest tree, GRANT_ABILITY INDESTRUCTIBLE EOT over FAnd(CONTROLLER_IS YOU, TYPE_EQ Creature, IS_ATTACKING), also covers creatures put onto the battlefield attacking before it resolves (CR 508.4; e.g. Basri Ket's -2 Soldier tokens from the same declaration: stronger than printed). The event maps: DeclareAttackersEvent(filter=FAnd(CONTROLLER_IS YOU, TYPE_EQ Creature)) (Tide Skimmer; fires once per declaration).
